{{Quote|The modulator controls the signals that make the leg move. If we can get a complete diagram of its circuitry our people might be able to come up with a device that will jam or disrupt those control signals. If we can do that ... well those things hit the ground pretty hard.|[[Droma Ordo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Modulator Retrieval|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''RX-8 modulators''' were used in the legs of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to control the signals that made the legs move.<ref name="SWG:MR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was looking into developing [[Jammer/Legends|jamming devices]] that could interfere with the AT-AT's locomotion. When [[Droma Ordo]] learned that [[Valarian Syndicate|people]] working for [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]] had recovered the leg of an AT-AT, he sent a Rebel agent to infiltrate the [[Valarian Depot]] and remove the modulator from the leg to analyze its circuitry. The schematics were sent back to Ordo.<ref name="SWG:MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
RX-8 modulators appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
